# Soil

`material`

Loose earth under the turf, down to the biome's topsoil depth. It is what mining natural grass-covered ground yields, and what farmland is made of.

> Give digging the surface a yield that is not rock

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| density | decimal | g/cm³ |
| hardness | decimal | Mohs equivalent 1–10 |
| depthBand | json | Depth band [min, max) in world units below the natural surface where a vein may form; empty when max <= min. A topsoil layer, never a buried vein. |
| leyGated | boolean | True when a vein of this material forms only near a ley line |
